title: A profile with no Forward lambda reports a missing tau
body: In `ProfileBuilder::build` (`profile.rs`), a missing `fwd_lambda` returns the error `missing: tau`, the same text as a missing `fwd_tau`. The message for a missing lambda should say lambda. Seen at `1e1bac3`.
close_reason: Fixed in `bb3c392`: `ProfileBuilder::build` now reports `missing: lambda`, with a test in `profile.rs` and a libnail changelog entry.
